title_en: 11oz 250th Anniversary Coffee Mug, Born 1776 Still Rising Ceramic Cup with Double-Sided Print, White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe, Patriotic USA Gift

5 INTERIOR COLORS - choose White, Black, Pink, Red, or Blue interior; glossy white exterior suits every kitchen and desk
PREMIUM 11oz CERAMIC - 11 oz / 330 ml, food-grade glaze, safe for dishwasher and microwave
GIFT-READY - a star-spangled present for July 4th, Veterans Day, Memorial Day, housewarmings, or any proud American

description_en:
Celebrate 250 years with a mug that says it plainly: born 1776, still rising lettering with a rising sun wraps this 11 oz ceramic cup in red, white and navy, printed on both sides so the design shows from any angle. Glossy white body, your choice of interior color, and a print baked for long-lasting color. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Packed securely for safe delivery.

Perfect for the flag-on-the-porch household, the history buff, and anyone raising a cup to the land of the free.
